meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 引导你逐步为某个聊天频道创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体:选定频道、确认你的用户身份后运行脚本生成智能体,并通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行,你想为某个聊天频道创建第一个智能体时,它会接管引导流程。

say.text: 帮我为 Discord 创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体
say.note: 会先问你选哪个频道、你的身份信息。

say.text: 我想让智能体通过 Telegram 给我发欢迎私信
say.note: 它会引导你完成配对并触发欢迎私信。

say.text: 开始初始化第一个智能体吧
say.note: 如果服务已运行,它会按步骤带你配置。

howto.what_en: Guides you step by step through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a messaging channel: pick the channel, confirm your identity, run the init script, and have the agent send you a welcome DM through the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create the first agent for a channel, after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

say_en.text: Help me create the first NanoClaw agent for Discord.
say_en.note: It will ask which channel and collect your identity.

say_en.text: I want the agent to send me a welcome DM on Telegram.
say_en.note: It will guide you through pairing and trigger the welcome DM.
If the service is running, it walks you through setup.
